title: Graduate civil engineer - expression of interest (Melbourne)
content_text: Breese Pitt Dixon careers page (Hawthorn East VIC). For more than 40 years BPD has helped shape Melbourne's land development industry through civil engineering, surveying and planning. Civil engineers deliver practical solutions designing major estates and critical infrastructure such as wetlands, retarding basins, trunk sewers, drainage and roads, and managing delivery through tendering, contract management and superintendent roles. Who we're looking for includes Graduate and experienced civil engineers; Survey Assistants, Technicians, Draftspersons; planners; construction professionals. Even if we're not recruiting in your discipline right now, we'd still like to hear from you. How to get in touch: We don't advertise individual vacancies here. If you'd like to explore a career with Breese Pitt Dixon, email us an introduction with your CV and a short note on the kind of work you're looking for. Email your expression of interest to info@bpd.com.au. We review every application, and if there's a potential fit now or later, we'll be in touch. Office: 1/19 Cato Street Hawthorn East VIC 3123. Phone +61 3 8823 2300.
apply_instructions: Email introduction with CV and short note on preferred work to info@bpd.com.au (careers page).
